sources.name: JMdict Japanese–English
sources.attribution: JMdict © James William Breen and the Electronic Dictionary Research and Development Group (EDRDG).
sources.changes: English component normalized to JSON; split compatible spelling/reading pairs and filter restricted senses; preserve supplied usage qualifiers; omit examples, priorities, cross-references and etymology. Gzip compressed.
sources.updatePolicy: EDRDG licence section 4 requires regular updates from the latest available data. The deployment maintainer must review and rebuild JMdict at least monthly, starting no later than 2026-10-05 for this release; run source/license review, pin new hashes, run tests, publish an immutable pack and updated manifest. Review upstream license and extraction changes before each manual rebuild. Pin source bytes and SHA256 in sources.lock.json, run normalization and integrity tests, publish a new immutable filename and manifest version; retain attribution and share-alike. No automatic upstream fetch in the application.

sources.attribution: CC-CEDICT contributors; published by MDBG. Based on CEDICT © 1997, 1998 Paul Andrew Denisowski.
sources.changes: All published entries normalized to JSON; preserve traditional/simplified spellings, numbered pinyin and complete slash-delimited glosses. Source-line SHA256 identifiers; gzip compressed.
sources.updatePolicy: No licence-imposed update cadence identified. Review upstream license and extraction changes before each manual rebuild. Pin source bytes and SHA256 in sources.lock.json, run normalization and integrity tests, publish a new immutable filename and manifest version; retain attribution and share-alike. No automatic upstream fetch in the application.

sources.name: Vietnamese Wiktionary Japanese–Vietnamese
sources.attribution: Vietnamese Wiktionary contributors; extracted by Kaikki.org / Wiktextract (Tatu Ylonen and contributors). Author credits linked in the source notice.
sources.changes: All raw ja records normalized; only canonical page headword, supplied ruby/pronunciations, POS and Vietnamese glosses with usage labels retained. No generated readings or translations. Examples, media, inflections, links and etymology omitted. Gzip compressed.
